title: The Pawn in Front
setup: White's king has just arrived on c4, and the two e-pawns are jammed against each other.
hint: White's king is two files away from the e-file; ask what changes if the blockade in front of your pawn goes.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Kxe5}} turns a dead pawn into a runner with its own king already ahead of it. White cannot hold the file: {{Kd3}} {{Kf4}} {{Ke2}} {{Ke4}} and Black outflanks it all the way down. Three of the king retreats lose outright, and the fourth only draws.
